description: UGC NET Psychology interactive learning platform
content_policy: Syllabus wording is source-derived; learning tools and starter guidance are platform scaffolding.
features: split-screen landscape progress card and wrapped daily study cards
full-viewport landscape progress card and multi-line study cards
micro-topic hierarchy and persistent non-overlay install controls
review calendar fallback for missed website visits
accessible responsive primary navigation with active state
desktop tablet landscape and mobile adaptive layout hardening
content_note: v9.1 prioritizes spaced-repetition reviews in the progress block and carries missed reviews forward as overdue rather than silently skipping them. A calendar export provides an external reminder fallback when the learner does not open the website.
